newsitem.title: UK: C&W indicated lower as results meet forecasts.
newsitem.headline: C&W indicated lower as results meet forecasts.

text.p: Shares in Cable and Wireless Plc (C&W) eased in early trading, in line with the market, after the company released yearly results showing profits met analysts' expectations.
The stock shed 1p to 511-1/2p by 0713 GMT.
C&W said pre-tax profit rose 12 percent to 1,418.0 million stg, compared with forecasts of 1,325.0-1,400.0 million.
"The results were pretty much in line with expectations after stripping out about 108 million of one-offs. We won't be changing our forecasts," said ABN AMRO Hoare Govett analyst, James Ross.
"The margin performance looked good and is mainly down to tight cost control which bodes well for the future," Ross said.
He noted a particular improvement in figures from the Caribbean. Turnover rose to 603 million for the Caribbean for 548 million in 1996 and operating profit to 194 from 179 million, C&W said.
Analysts said they expect a steady performance from C&W shares on Wednesday.
